name: @w6w-apps/todoist
description: Manage Todoist tasks, projects, sections, comments, and labels via the REST v2 API.

w6w.longDescription:
Todoist is a task manager, and this app is the everyday task-management loop from a workflow: create, read, update, close and reopen tasks, manage the projects and sections that organize them, add comments, and read labels.

Closing and reopening a task, and deleting a task or a project, map onto Todoist's own lightweight completion model, so a workflow can mark something done without a full update call. This app covers the REST v2 surface, which is the everyday task and project workflow; Todoist's separate Sync API — used for bulk operations, reminders and quick natural-language task entry — isn't reached here, since task placement (which project, section, or parent task) is already expressible directly at creation time.

This is a straightforward, focused app: a workflow that needs to turn an external event into a Todoist task, update one as work progresses, or read back a project's open items has everything it needs, without the bulk-sync machinery Todoist offers for its own native clients.
